proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON WHETHER TO ALLOW STOCKHOLDERS TO ACT BY WRITTEN CONSENT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders to act by written consent, with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a meeting, consistent with applicable law.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote against this proposal because the Board views the change that the proposal requests as contrary to the best interests of our stockholders

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS COST-BENEFIT ANALYSIS REPORT
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc., Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on a cost-benefit analysis of Intel and IPAC political and electioneering contributions and their risks to shareholder value.
